text_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ
context_ar: الآية تتناول التثبت من الخبر قبل ترتيب أثر قد يضر بالناس. لا يستخدم BAYYIN الآية لإصدار حكم فقهي على حالة بعينها.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
context_en: This verse addresses verifying news before acting on it in a way that could harm people. BAYYIN does not use this verse to issue a ruling on any specific case.

text_ar: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا
context_ar: نص قرآني مرتبط بعدم اتباع ما لا علم للإنسان به. يُعرض هنا كمصدر نصي، لا كفتوى على واقعة محددة.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: And do not pursue[745] that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
context_en: A Qur'anic text related to not following what one has no knowledge of. Presented here as a textual source, not as a ruling on a specific case.

text_ar: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
context_ar: الآية ضمن سياق الإفك وتحذر من تداول قول لا علم به والاستهانة بخطورته.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: When you received it with your tongues[980] and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
context_en: A Qur'anic text on repeating claims one has no knowledge of. Presented here as a textual source, not a ruling on a specific case.

text_ar: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ
context_ar: الآية تأتي في سياق التعامل مع الإفك وعدم التحدث بما لا ينبغي تداوله.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?
context_en: Related to the previous verse; addresses the response expected upon hearing an unverified, harmful claim.

text_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
context_ar: الآية تأمر المؤمنين بتقوى الله والقول السديد. BAYYIN يعرض المصدر ولا يحول ذلك إلى أحكام آلية على الأشخاص.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.
context_en: General exhortation to truthful, upright speech. Presented as a textual source, not a ruling on a specific case.

text_ar: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
context_ar: النص ينهى عن خلط الحق بالباطل وكتمان الحق مع العلم به.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
context_en: General exhortation against mixing truth with falsehood or concealing known truth.

text_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَبْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا
context_ar: الآية تتناول جملة من الآداب منها اجتناب كثير من الظن والتجسس والغيبة.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.
context_en: Addresses avoiding baseless assumption, spying, and backbiting.

text_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَى أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى
context_ar: الآية تؤكد العدل حتى مع وجود البغضاء، ويجب عدم اقتطاعها من سياقها لإسقاطها على واقعة قانونية أو فقهية بلا مختص.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allāh, witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what you do.
context_en: General exhortation to justice even toward those one dislikes.

text_ar: فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
context_ar: جزء من الآية 43 من سورة النحل، ويُستشهد به على الرجوع لأهل العلم. السياق الكامل للآية ينبغي مراجعته عند الاستدلال.
provenance: Quranpedia.net; Sahih International English translation; verified 2026-10-01
text_en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
context_en: Commonly cited regarding referring questions to those with specialized knowledge. BAYYIN treats this as a reason to route sensitive/unclear questions to a qualified specialist rather than answer them itself.

text_ar: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
context_ar: هذا جزء مشهور من حديث عمر رضي الله عنه في صحيح البخاري. التطبيق يعرض المصدر فقط ولا يستنبط منه حكمًا فقهيًا آليًا.
provenance: Dorar.net; Sahih al-Bukhari 1; source and grading verified 2026-10-01
text_en: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will have what they intended.
context_en: One of the most widely cited hadith on the role of intention in actions. Presented as a textual source, not a ruling on a specific case.
source_authority: Dorar.net Hadith Encyclopedia; source record: Sahih al-Bukhari 1

text_ar: وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
context_ar: هذا جزء من حديث يتضمن كذلك حق الجار وإكرام الضيف. عرض الجملة منفردة لا يغني عن الرجوع للحديث كاملًا عند الدراسة.
provenance: Dorar.net; Sahih al-Bukhari 6018; source and grading verified 2026-10-01
text_en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
context_en: Addresses restraint in speech. The full hadith text covers additional topics.
source_authority: Dorar.net Hadith Encyclopedia; source record: Sahih al-Bukhari 6018
text_en_role: English display rendering for search/accessibility; Arabic source text is the primary evidence.
translation_source: Project English rendering (not used as the primary source text)

text_ar: كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ كَذِبًا أَنْ يُحَدِّثَ بِكُلِّ مَا سَمِعَ
context_ar: ورد في مقدمة صحيح مسلم في باب النهي عن الحديث بكل ما سمع. مناسب لموضوع التثبت من تداول الأخبار.
provenance: Dorar.net; Sahih Muslim 5 (Introduction); source and grading verified 2026-10-01
text_en: It is enough for a person to be considered untruthful that he narrates everything he hears.
context_en: Cited in the introduction to Sahih Muslim regarding the discipline of not repeating unverified reports.
source_authority: Dorar.net Hadith Encyclopedia; source record: Sahih Muslim 5 (Introduction)
